g.text: Unplaced eukaryotes: 105 G/R and 14 organelle-host labels; retained in totals, omitted from the dated tree.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #43525c

g.text: Additional training components include metagenomes, viral sequences and plasmids; these have no corresponding source rows in this metadata file.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #43525c

g.text: Counts are unique labels within source groups, not training weights or genome counts. Organelles are assigned to their hosts; viruses are not branches of this cellular tree.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #43525c

g.text: Eukaryotic branches use TimeTree point estimates (Ma); within-group diversification is collapsed. Microbial bars have no evolutionary-time scale.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #65727a

g.text: Sources: arcinstitute/opengenome2 species_metadata.csv @ 84d2a7e690c8; TimeTree web export, 2026-11-17. Metadata taxonomy: GTDB and NCBI.
